title: Be Me Workspace Identity (v1)
description: A trusted registry object, never a value inferred from requests. Request paths, remotes, repository contents, and workspace_hint are untrusted matching signals only: they cannot create registration, grant authorization, or widen policy. A clone is not trusted because it shares a remote.

items.description: Authorized real paths. Reference form: workspace-id::relative/path. Path moves require a trusted registry update.

expected_remote_identity.description: Normalized Git remote identity when present. A matching remote is a signal, not an approval credential.

sensitivity_namespace.description: Namespaced work_restricted:<workspace-id>. Cross-namespace joins denied by default.

bound_project_policy.description: Trusted project policy requires this out-of-band registration. Git tracking/author identity/branch protection is not approval.
